aws-cli.purpose: Operate and inspect AWS resources from approved cloud-oriented development profiles.

security.notes: Credentials must remain external to Realm images and repository source.

aws-cli.rationale: Useful cloud client already represented in the capability catalog, but stable inclusion waits for an immutable package/version lock and smoke test.

security.notes: Legacy client is no longer the preferred Docker Compose architecture.

docker-compose-v1.rationale: Superseded by the maintained Compose v2 plugin architecture; do not add the legacy client to stable profiles.

docker-compose-v2.purpose: Compose multi-container development services when a service-enabled profile explicitly requests them.

security.notes: Compose can control the configured container engine; keep it out of non-service profiles unless explicitly required.

docker-compose-v2.rationale: Preferred Compose architecture, but Realm has not yet pinned and tested the plugin as a stable profile capability.

ffmpeg.purpose: Provide media inspection, transcoding, extraction, and conversion capabilities for media-oriented repositories.

security.notes: Treat untrusted media as hostile input and keep decoder exposure current through package updates.

ffmpeg.rationale: Already represented in the media capability, but stable inclusion waits for exact package locking and representative smoke tests.

google-cloud-cli.purpose: Operate and inspect Google Cloud resources from approved cloud-oriented development profiles.

security.notes: Authentication state and application-default credentials must not be baked into images.

google-cloud-cli.rationale: Already represented in the capability catalog, but a stable immutable source and architecture-specific validation are not yet recorded.

node.purpose: Provide the JavaScript/TypeScript runtime required by Node-based repositories and tooling.

security.notes: Package-manager credentials and registries remain consumer configuration.

node.rationale: Pinned runtime already represented by the node-toolchain capability and directly owned by the Node profile.

opentofu.purpose: Provide a Terraform-compatible infrastructure-as-code client for cloud and infrastructure development.

security.notes: Can mutate remote infrastructure; Realm supplies tooling only. Credentials, state, apply authorization, and IaC modules belong outside the image.

opentofu.rationale: Pinned artifact already declared by the cloud-cli capability. Stable inclusion is tooling-only and does not grant apply authority.

pulumi.purpose: Provide a programmable infrastructure-as-code client for repositories that explicitly choose Pulumi.

security.notes: Can mutate remote infrastructure; credentials, backends, policy, state, and deployment intent remain consumer concerns.

pulumi.rationale: Pinned artifact already declared by the cloud-cli capability; inclusion supports consumers without making Pulumi mandatory.

rustup.purpose: Install and select pinned Rust toolchains for Rust development profiles.

security.notes: Toolchain downloads must be versioned by the consuming profile; avoid curl-to-shell installation paths in image builds.

rustup.rationale: Pinned artifact already represented by the rust-toolchain capability and directly owned by the Rust profile.

strace.purpose: Provide bounded process-level syscall diagnostics for Linux development and debugging.

security.notes: Tracing may expose sensitive process arguments or data; use intentionally and do not persist traces by default.

strace.rationale: Lower-privilege diagnostics candidate; stable inclusion waits for a diagnostics profile and exact package lock.

sysdig.purpose: Provide host/container runtime inspection when an explicit privileged diagnostic profile is justified.

security.notes: Full functionality may require kernel access or elevated capabilities; never make the default development image privileged for this tool.

sysdig.rationale: Potentially useful diagnostics do not justify expanding default runtime privileges. Revisit only with a bounded opt-in profile and consumer requirement.

security.notes: Infrastructure mutation and state concerns are equivalent to other IaC clients.

terraform.rationale: Do not add a second Terraform-compatible client to the stable profile without a concrete compatibility requirement. OpenTofu currently satisfies the generic capability with a pinned source.
